camel_example: aliyun oos ChangeResourceGroup --region cn-hangzhou --NewResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm3peow3k0000' --ResourceId TemplateName --ResourceType template --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Modifies the resource group to which a cloud resource belongs
description_zh: 修改云资源所属的资源组
kebab_example: aliyun oos change-resource-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id TemplateName --new-resource-group-id rg-acfm3peow3k0000 --resource-type template --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The resource ID of the cloud resource for which you want to modify the resource group.

If ResourceType is set to template, ResourceId is set to TemplateName.

If ResourceType is set to parameter, ResourceId is set to Name.

If ResourceType is set to secretparameter, ResourceId is set to Name.

If ResourceType is set to stateconfiguration, ResourceId is set to StateConfigurationId.

If ResourceType is set to application, ResourceId is set to Name
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改资源组的云资源的资源ID。

当ResourceType为template时，ResourceId为TemplateName;

当ResourceType为parameter时，ResourceId为Name；

当ResourceType为secretparameter时，ResourceId为Name；

当ResourceType为stateconfiguration时，ResourceId为StateConfigurationId。

当ResourceType为application时，ResourceId为Name
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which you want to move the cloud resource instance. A resource group is a mechanism for managing resources by group within an Alibaba Cloud account. Resource groups help you resolve complex issues related to resource grouping and authorization management within a single cloud account. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html
parameters.help_zh: 需要移入云资源实例的资源组ID。资源组是在阿里云账号下进行资源分组管理的一种机制，资源组能够帮助您解决单个云账号内的资源分组和授权管理等复杂性问题。详细信息，请参见什么是https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the cloud resource for which you want to modify the resource group. Valid values:

template: template.
parameter: parameter.
secretparameter: encrypted parameter.
stateconfiguration: desired state configuration.
application: application
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改资源组的云资源类型，取值：

template：模板。
parameter：参数。
secretparameter：加密参数。
stateconfiguration：终态配置。
application：应用
parameters.name: resource_type
